name: fix-kalide-rename-sweep-agents
body: source: kalide-rename name-sweep AC excluding only git history, vendored third-party code and apg/; inconsistency: `.opencode/agents/` holds generated agent definitions that mention the old names and are regenerated by agent-builder after merge, so plan tasks cannot and should not hand-edit them, making the AC unsatisfiable (plan feedback-21); resolution: added `.opencode/agents/` to the sweep exclusions; allowed-match list unchanged [with user, coordinator-approved]
